calendarPageDescription: A calendar sets days and hours, such as working hours. Link it to notifications or areas so they work only at those times.

privacyScope: The app hides locations on the map, in replay and in reports. Traccar still stores every position, and anyone with direct access to the server can see it. privacyNoticeTemplate:
Notice to employees about vehicle location

{Company name} runs a tracking system (GPS) in company vehicles. This notice explains what is collected, why, and your rights.

What is collected: the vehicle's location, speed, driving and stop times, distance, and driving events such as harsh acceleration and braking.

Why: fleet management and job assignment, road safety, handling accidents and traffic tickets, and vehicle maintenance.

When: during working hours. Outside working hours, and while private mode is on in the driver area, the location is not shown and only the distance is kept.

Who sees it: fleet managers and the safety officer, according to their permissions. Every look at a location is recorded.

How long it is kept: {number} days.

Your rights: to see the information about you, to ask to correct it, and to ask any question of {name and contact}.
